prompt: In the town where the most successful American Ace of World War 2 to survive that war was born, there is a college. What was the name and percentage of the largest demographic of full and part time students attending that college in 2020?
answer: Richard Bong was born in **Superior, Wisconsin**, where the college is the **University of Wisconsin–Superior**. In 2020, its largest enrollment category was **full-time students**, comprising approximately **65% of undergraduates** (with part-time students making up about 35%).
